summary: Measured CPU/device dispatch with host working-set admission, exact source plans and native router/shared fusion
implementation_scope: Host placement, measured capacity-bounded prefix splits with immutable calibration identities and exact-count timing medians, and mixed-source plans; compact-batch CUDA FP8 router/shared-SwiGLU entry and top-k/shared-down grid. Timing collection, allocation and routed-expert arithmetic remain external. Optional exact-identity HostMemoryCosts account for CPU scratch, loader bytes, pinned staging and additional file pages on CPU and upload paths; injected admission gates ranking and can be revalidated before allocation.

agent_guidance.use_when: Compare placement or mixed-source dispatch, select CPU/device splits from measured workload-specific costs, or combine independent router/shared-expert branches for 1-8 tokens
agent_guidance.avoid_when: Dispatch adds no useful choice and branch launches are not a bottleneck; native fusion requires the declared FP8/BF16 layouts, SiLU product and selected-logit softmax semantics; measured lane curves require comparable work geometry and explicit overlap, otherwise measure whole candidate implementations
provides: Feasible host-prefix/device-suffix plans including fixed bytes and headroom
Occurrence-preserving split dispatch and weighted contribution combination
Measured CPU/upload/device cost curves, exact identity checks and byte/occurrence-bounded prefix split ranking without interpolation
Deduplicated exact miss demands, protected-source plan validation and one quantize/project handoff
One-grid FP8 router and shared gate/up projection with BF16 SiLU product
One-grid deterministic top-k/selected softmax and independent BF16 shared-down projection
Per-candidate anonymous/pinned/file working-set costs and admission reasons; fresh admission revalidation before submission
engine_supplies: Validated encoded device views, routed-expert arithmetic, model-specific shared gating and physical placement
Protected READY snapshot plus complete scratch staging before reads
Exact fallback execution, receipts and measured strategy selection
Matched current model/layout/workload/code/topology identities, measured lane and common-overhead samples under representative contention, valid dual-path misses and protected resident sources
Disjoint incremental peak costs and fresh OS observations, independent device reservations, allocation failure cleanup and an admitted exact fallback
preserve: Every occurrence keeps its expert identity, position and weight
Repeated experts share compatible sources; scratch cannot alias READY content
Overflow uses exact fallback rather than wrapping expert IDs
Miss substitution and gate reweighting are outside this exact dispatch contract and require separate consumer quality criteria
Routing ties select the lower original expert ID; shared-down output is unweighted and kept separate from routed contributions
Never rank an unmeasured split as zero cost; deduplicate bundle uploads while retaining every weighted route occurrence; calibration identities must match
Missing memory estimates cannot win; file-backed working sets are not automatically charged as anonymous commit; admission snapshots do not reserve memory
adapt: Static placement order and source-selection policy
Host/device routing, staging and kernel fusion
Scratch capacity and arithmetic implementation under declared criteria
Miss ordering, calibrated work classes, CPU/device overlap model and occurrence/staging limits

code_files.purpose: Executable host placement and source-selection algorithms; optimized quantization, projection and staging are explicit backend hooks
Immutable sample curves and identities; measured prefix dispatch planning with exact routes, unique uploads, explicit overlap and capacity/missing-data handling
Native router/shared branch geometry, routing semantics and ownership
Fused compact-batch FP8 entry and independent routing/shared-down CUDA grid
Native fusion library and FP8 dependency build

requires.hardware: Python 3.11+ and standard library for the host reference; backend hardware is an engine choice; C++/CUDA20 and SM80+ for the optional fused component
requires.model: Expert-routed execution with explicit route occurrences and compatible source representations
requires.workload: Memory-constrained placement or mixed-source routed projections; fixed/scratch capacities use different units; native router/shared fusion supports 1-8 tokens, 1-1024 experts and top-k up to 32

contract.input: Ordered routing occurrences; protected READY slot/generation snapshot, explicit capacity and disjoint scratch; static allocation groups and fixed/workspace/headroom byte extents; native fusion takes contiguous encoded matrices/activations and caller-owned output spans/stream; measured planning also takes current calibration identity, raw timing curves, complete upload extents and staging/route limits; optional HostMemoryCosts with exact route/upload tables and an injected admission callback
contract.output: Host/device partitions or a single exact cache/scratch/stock plan with deduplicated staging demands; one quantize/project submission through declared hooks; feasible static prefix plans; native router scores, BF16 shared activations, original expert IDs/weights and unweighted FP32 shared output; feasible measured split candidates with missing-sample reasons and an optional best estimate; incremental host memory bytes and admission decisions/reasons retained for each candidate
contract.ownership: Caller retains leases for every source, route buffer, activation and result until completion. READY snapshots do not pin owners; scratch is reserved for the operation.
contract.failure: Reject conflicting/duplicate occurrences, invalid weights, source-slot aliases, unprotected scratch overlap, invalid generations and fabricated demands. Scratch exhaustion preserves original stock expert IDs. Measured planning rejects identity mismatches and invalid samples; absent samples cannot win and no measured feasible plan returns best=None for caller fallback. Missing or rejected memory costs cannot win; failed revalidation requires replanning or exact fallback before allocation/submission.
contract.core_boundary: Consumer owns partition policy/arithmetic; core owns physical services and producer quiescence.

dependencies: CUDA toolkit, CMake 3.28+ and the quantized-projections native component

validation.host: Host fixtures and worked example cover budget feasibility, repeated routes, exact fallback, scratch separation and one activation preparation; measured policy fixtures check median/sparse/nonlinear costs, identity changes, explicit overlap, byte and occurrence limits, arbitrary widths, repeated expert uploads and weighted result preservation; RAM/commit/cgroup limits, unknown costs/observations, distinct experts and upload sources, fresh revalidation, zero incremental resident paths and route preservation
validation.native: RTX 5090 CUDA fixtures compare 24 router/shared fusion cases to host arithmetic and shared activations exactly to separate CUDA calls; selected softmax, ties and aliases are checked. Mixed cache/stock expert kernels and complete model behavior remain consumer work
validation.performance: Unmeasured for a native engine; host fixture success is not a speed claim

native_integration.status: Native router/shared branch fusion supplied; mixed-source routed-expert arithmetic and physical cache staging remain engine services
required_hooks: Route-preserving projection arithmetic and physical source/result ownership for the selected path
One quantization and one source-aware projection hook when execute_mixed is selected
Complete scratch-bundle staging before projection reads when scratch is used
Scheduler copies and projection use the same protected READY snapshot/version when caching is used
native_integration.integration_scope: Optional consumer dispatch. Split execution does not require the mixed-source hook or device routing.
optimization_candidates: Choose a unified cache/stock native projection over split execution when duplicate work is a measured bottleneck
Device route resolution without host readback
native_integration.first_native_milestone: Real-layer mixed resident/original projection, exact misses and scheduler copies using the same protected snapshot, with actual backend placement asserted after allocation and activation provenance declared. Then verify full-model decode and source transitions independently; isolated parity or configuration tuning is insufficient.
